en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European village at the edge of a forested hillside. In the foreground is a long, ivy‑covered timber or masonry building with a tiled roof and several windows; in front of it stands a woman in a long dress. To the right are outdoor tables and chairs suggesting an inn or guesthouse garden. Behind the houses rises a church with a steep roof and a square tower topped by a small spire, set against densely wooded, hilly terrain.
